name: Asam Rebus
hint: clear tamarind/asam sour boiled fish or chicken soup-dish, lighter than asam pedas because there is no thick fried sambal base; variants ikan kembung, ikan merah, ayam kampung

name: Ayam Goreng
hint: Malay-style fried chicken, marinated and deep fried with skin on; variants berempah (spiced batter), kunyit (turmeric), cili padi daun kari; skin and oil drive calories

name: Paru Goreng
hint: deep-fried spiced beef lung, crispy offal eaten as lauk with rice or as a snack at nasi campur stalls; chewy, oil absorbed in frying

name: Kerang Masak
hint: cockles (blood clams) cooked in sauce; lean high-protein shellfish where the sauce drives calories; variants masak sambal pedas, masak kicap

name: Lala Masak
hint: clams (lala) stir-fried; light shellfish, calories mostly from oil and sauce; variants cili padi, masak halia (ginger and spring onion)

name: Ikan Goreng
hint: plain Malay fried fish, whole or cut, fried until crisp; lean protein but absorbs frying oil; variants talapia, ikan kembung, cencaru sumbat sambal

name: Ikan Stim
hint: steamed fish, one of the leanest restaurant dishes; variants stim limau (lime and chili), halia (ginger), with light soy; ikan merah or siakap typical

name: Sup Daging
hint: clear spiced beef soup with tender beef chunks, eaten with bread; broth light, beef and any marrow add the calories; variant berempah

name: Sup Ikan
hint: fish soup; variants clear sup ikan and asam-pedas-style sour fish soup; light, lean protein, low oil

name: Sup Sayur
hint: clear mixed vegetable soup (sup sayur bening) with cabbage, carrot, tomato; very low calorie, almost free; the diet-friendliest soup

name: Bubur Jagung
hint: sweet corn dessert porridge in coconut milk with sago or sweet potato, served warm; santan and sugar drive calories

name: Pulut
hint: steamed glutinous rice; variants pulut sambal (with sambal ikan bilis), pulut inti (sweet grated coconut topping), pulut kuning (turmeric coconut glutinous rice); dense carbs, santan

name: Ketupat
hint: compressed rice cake boiled in woven palm-leaf pouch; eaten at Raya with rendang or kuah kacang; variants ketupat nasi (white rice), ketupat palas (glutinous in palas leaf, richer with santan)

name: Ketupat Sotong
hint: squid stuffed with glutinous rice simmered in sweet coconut-milk gravy, Terengganu/Kelantan specialty; santan and sugar make it calorie dense

name: Lemang
hint: glutinous rice with coconut milk roasted in bamboo lined with banana leaf; eaten with rendang or serunding at Raya; rich from santan

name: Masak Kicap
hint: protein braised in sweet dark soy sauce (kicap manis) with onion and chili; variants ayam kampung, ikan kembung, telur, daging; sugar in the kicap adds up

name: Masak Merah
hint: protein in a sweet tomato-chili sauce, a kenduri staple; variants ayam, ikan merah, daging lembu, udang; oil and sugar in the sauce drive calories

name: Sayur Campur
hint: mixed stir-fried kampung vegetables (cabbage, carrot, beans, sometimes tofu); low calorie apart from the cooking oil; variant with oyster sauce

name: Sambal Petai
hint: petai (stink beans) in sambal tumis, usually with prawns or ikan bilis; iconic; calories from the sambal oil and any prawns, petai itself moderate
